item.title: Phantom Blade Zero: How to Reach Old Man Gen's House in Pangzhen (The Journey Home)
item.description:
The Journey Home is a side quest given by Old Man Gen in Phantom Blade Zero , who'll ask Soul to visit his house in Pangzhen and check on his wife. This can get a bit tricky, as a lot of areas in Pangzhen are either inaccessible or locked behind a Phantom Edge. Here's a quick guide to help players reach Old Man Gen's house in Pangzhen and progress The Journey Home quest.

Add GameRant on Google Add as Preferred Source Follow on Google Discover
Phantom Blade Zero: How to Enter the Blacksmith Shop (The Sword and the Way)

Here's how players can enter the blacksmith shop to get the Bronze Essence during the Sword and the Way quest in Phantom Blade Zero.

By Ayyoun Ali

How to Reach Old Man Gen's House in Pangzhen (The Journey Home)

Once you reach Pangzhen, the first thing you'll need to do is progress normally through the region until you enter the Lion Dance Hall and get the Flaming Mane Phantom Edge. Once you have it, head to the Pond of Fading Song and use the Flaming Mane at the marker in the image above.

This will open up the path to Pangzhen Slums , where you'll find Old Man Gen's house for the Journey Home quest in Phantom Blade Zero .

Now, you'll need to follow the mountainous trail, and you'll enter the slums at the back of Pangzhen. Make your way over the rooftops of houses until you reach the Pangzhen Slums bell on street level .

While you're in the area, I'd recommend completing the A Mother's Heart quest.

Near the bell, you'll see a ladder heading to the upper levels of the slums. You'll need to climb up the ladder until you reach the houses in the upper section. Head left after reaching topside to enter a street of houses, and you'll arrive at the Old Man Gen's House bell .

Enter the house using the key Old Man Gen gave you at the end of the Village of Lu, and you'll find his wife inside, deceased. Interact with her body, and you'll get a Dusty Old Wooden Comb story item .

Use the bell to fast travel to Old Man Gen's house on the outskirts of the Village of Lu, and you'll complete the second phase of The Journey Home quest in Phantom Blade Zero.

How to Find Old Man Gen Again & Complete The Journey Home Quest

To fully complete Old Man Gen's quest in Phantom Blade Zero , you'll need to reach the Meigu Lake region. Once you do, take your boat up north, and you'll spot a dock in a frozen landscape on the lake.

Right after docking your boat at the Four Guardians Mirror Island, you'll immediately get a cutscene with Old Man Gen, who'll reward players with the War Wagon Phantom Edge as a thank you. After giving the Phantom Edge, he'll blissfully pass away in the spot where players will be able to pick up his Memory Flower.

item.title: Brand-New PlayStation Game for 2027 Leaked Online
item.description:
A recent leak hints at a brand-new PlayStation game in development at Bend Studio, the creator of Days Gone , expected to be a co-op project launching in 2027. The PlayStation game will be the first new release from Bend Studio since the launch of Days Gone in 2019.

Add GameRant on Google Add as Preferred Source Follow on Google Discover

While Bend Studio has been largely quiet in recent years, the developer was once a mainstay on PlayStation consoles. As Eidetic and later under the Sony Computer Entertainment umbrella, Bend Studio helped to create the Syphon Filter series, which was met with critical acclaim and saw multiple Syphon Filter games on the PS1, PS2, and PSP. Bend Studio's last major release was the 2019 zombie action game Days Gone , which, despite receiving middling reviews from fans and critics, sold more than 7 million copies. Now, Bend Studio may be preparing a comeback with a brand-new game.

PlayStation Job Listing Threatens PS5 Dynamic Pricing

A new job listing from PlayStation suggests that Sony may be considering the implementation of dynamic pricing for its digital PS5 games.

By Michael Brandon Ingram

Bend Studio is Reportedly Working on a New Game

Speaking to MP1st, an anonymous Bend Studio employee shed light on what the studio has been working on. The game is set to be a third-person, co-op experience that reportedly won't be a live-service title, with no mention of whether it will be a new IP or an adaptation. The mystery game is also said to be "much further along in development" than people might expect, following the reported cancellation of multiple games from Bend Studio in 2025, including a live-service game that was codenamed "Mirror Pond." The anonymous employee also hinted at the game's release window, claiming it will be both announced and released in 2027.

Though the Bend Studio employee did not confirm any details about the game's branding, it is not expected to be from the Days Gone universe. The developer had pitched a sequel to Days Gone to Sony following the first game's release, though the poor performance of the first game is said to have contributed to the proposal's rejection. Director Jeff Ross has previously gone on record as saying that Days Gone will never receive a sequel from Sony, due to executives at the studio not being keen on the game.

Can you name them both?

Days Gone Remastered received its most recent update in October 2025 with the release of the 1.036.180 patch, which made the game playable when using the PlayStation 5's Power Saver mode. The game has not received a major content update since April 2025, with the release of the Broken Road DLC for Days Gone Remastered , which added the new Horde Assault and Permadeath game modes. Bend Studio has not made any announcement about its rumored new project.

Bend Studio's new release is set to join some major games already slated to hit the PS5 in 2027. Sony will kick off the year with the return of Until Dawn in January, seeing developer Firesprite officially release the long-awaited Until Dawn 2 on January 28. The newest God of War game is also scheduled to debut early in the year, with the February 16 debut of God of War: Laufey serving as the first time in the franchise that Kratos will not be the protagonist. Sony looks to have exciting things in store for the PS5 in 2027, and Bend Studio's newest game will add even more to the lineup.

item.title: FBI Investigating Pokemon TCG Scam
item.description:
A Pokemon TCG buying scam that's caused sellers to lose tens of thousands of dollars is being actively investigated by the FBI. The crime tactic is just the latest in people looking to commit crimes around Pokemon TCG .

Add GameRant on Google Add as Preferred Source Follow on Google Discover

While Pokemon TCG has no connection to crime itself, that hasn't stopped people from taking advantage of the high value of some cards. Individual sellers and card shops alike have been targeted, with some going so far as to use chainsaws to break in and steal Pokemon TCG cards. As individual Pokemon cards are small and can often be extremely valuable, they've unfortunately become a common target.

Pokemon TCG Thieves Arrested After Stealing Over $200k in Cards

A pair of thieves have been arrested in Japan following a heist involving a collection of Pokemon cards valued at more than $200k.

By Marc Deschamps

FBI Investigates Pokemon Card Thefts

It's now been revealed that the Federal Bureau of Investigation is looking into numerous cases of scammers committing fraud to steal Pokemon cards. Between September 2025 and March 2026, reportedly at least seven stores in the New Jersey area were victims of these scams, with the supposed customers shopping for high-value cards. Upon trying to complete their purchase, the scammer would typically scan their phone on a touchless credit card reader, which would fail to process. After that, they'd ask to have the store enter a credit card number manually. The scammer would then provide a working - but stolen - credit card number and walk out the door with their ill-gotten gains. This has reportedly resulted in thousands of dollars worth of Pokemon cards being stolen.

Unfortunately, this method of stealing cards is a bit more complex than simply breaking into a store after-hours or committing armed robbery for Pokemon cards. Since the credit card transaction was processed successfully, store owners often didn't know they'd been scammed until the transaction was rejected after the fact. This usually happens when the actual credit card owner or their credit card company realizes that a suspicious purchase has been made, resulting in it bouncing, or the credit card account being closed entirely. By then, the thief is long gone, as are their stolen cards.

New Questions Added!

Results

The FBI has recommended that shops selling Pokemon TCG cards not utilize manual credit card entry for purchases in order to avoid scams like these. However, in some of the instances, a different method was used that could be even more problematic. Some of the thieves reportedly used an app on their phone that allowed them to store numerous credit card numbers, likely all stolen, and then cycle through them when using touch-to-pay until one successfully went through. Accordingly, shops have also been recommended to require proof of identification when any large purchases are made, regardless of the payment method used.

Pokemon TCG Reveals New Promo Cards A Year Before Release

FBI Investigating Pokemon TCG Scam
Bethesda Previews Big Fallout 76 Updates for December 2026 and Spring 2027

While the FBI may be successful in tracking down the person or people responsible for these scams, it seems unlikely that the shops will be able to recoup their lost property. It's likely that once the cards were taken, they were quickly resold to unsuspecting third parties. Sadly, Pokemon TCG collectors buying cards from individuals can easily end up buying contraband without realizing it, as there are no unique identifiers on individual cards that can be used to easily track them.

Sources: News 12, NJ.com

item.title: The Witcher & 5 Open-World RPGs Officially Returning In 2027
item.description:
These days, the line between classic single-player titles and live-service models is as thin as ever. With triple-A budgets and development times continuing to grow, companies increasingly support their games for years to keep them selling. In many cases, the full launch is just the start of a game’s journey. Several years later, a game might be almost unrecognizable , as post-launch support often introduces fresh content while tweaking and revamping existing mechanics.

Add GameRant on Google Add as Preferred Source Follow on Google Discover

CD Projekt Red’s latest games are among the best examples: both Cyberpunk 2077 and The Witcher 3 (following its Remastered treatment) have changed considerably since launch. As such, experiencing a game for the first time years later, or returning after a long break, can be fun and rewarding. This list is dedicated to open-world RPGs returning in 2027 , be it through a new expansion or massive update, a reboot of an iconic franchise, or a direct follow-up wrapping up a single story. Let’s see which games still have plenty in store for returning fans.

The Witcher 3: Songs of the Past

Coming TBA 2027

The Witcher 3’s grand comeback is a textbook example of a single-player game that just refuses to fade into history. More than ten years on, CDPR has revived Wild Hunt with the unexpected (and free!) Remastered update, and that’s just the beginning. To push things further, The Witcher 3 is getting a third major expansion, Songs of the Past , sometime next year, putting Geralt’s old friend Dandelion at the center of a new adventure that will presumably serve as a bridge between the Geralt trilogy and the upcoming Ciri saga.

Co-developed by CD Projekt Red and Fool’s Theory (the studio responsible for The Witcher 1 Remake ), Songs of the Past is described as closer in scope to Blood and Wine: a massive new region, Letten, branching storylines, new enemies and bosses, and even a new chain weapon for Geralt. Building on the improvements in the Remastered version, Songs of the Past could be its most interesting expansion in terms of gameplay, and there’s little doubt it will be a worthy addition to the legendary open-world RPG.

Fable

Coming February 23

Fable offers a different kind of return, but it’s nevertheless a perfect fit for the topic. A full-fledged franchise reboot from a new developer under the same name, arriving 17 years after Fable 3 , is about as long-awaited a comeback as it gets. The game will probably be vastly different from its predecessors, but based on the showcases, Playground Games has managed to capture Fable’s unmistakable spirit, which is what matters most.

New Turn-Based RPGs Basically Confirmed For 2027

These are the turn-based RPGs to watch in 2027, from Persona 4: Golden to UnderRail 2, big sequels and weird spin-offs are on the horizon.

By Ollie Tuscarny

The return to Albion with a customizable hero and British humor has one unbeatable ace up its sleeve beyond the new combat system and fully open world. So far, Fable looks like a true fantasy life simulator, with over 1,000 handcrafted NPCs, dynamic relationships, jobs, property ownership, and reputation all contributing to a world that feels alive and reactive. Iconic characters like Jack of Blades are also returning, promising unexpected twists and fresh takes on familiar lore. The only thing that’s slightly alarming is the developer’s estimate of around 20 hours for the main story, which seems particularly light for a massive open-world RPG.

Starfield: Starborn

Coming TBA 2027

In many ways, Starfield unfortunately failed to live up to expectations as the next major chapter for Bethesda’s open-world RPGs, but it could still be too early to write it off. Post-launch support has been pretty uneven, with both the Shattered Space and Terran Armada expansions doing too little to shake things up. Yet updates like Free Lanes have definitely been steps in the right direction for expanding and improving the experience.

New Open-World RPGs Basically Confirmed For 2027

From new entries in popular series to completely new IPs, 2027 looks promising for the open-world RPG genre, so what are we playing?

2
By Vlad Mazanko

That’s where Starborn (title unconfirmed) comes in. This is easily the least detailed return announcement on the list, so we don’t yet know whether “Starborn content” means a massive expansion, smaller DLC, or a major update like Free Lanes to further improve the base game for all owners. Still, Bethesda has promised Starborn for 2027, meaning Starfield will stay relevant into next year, potentially reaching its best form and offering an ideal entry point after more than three years of improvements.

Final Fantasy 7 Revelation

Coming April 8

Wait, what’s this doing here? Final Fantasy 7 Revelation isn’t a return, it’s a brand-new game! Sure, but it’s also a direct continuation of the new FF7 saga, meaning the return of Cloud, Tifa, Barret, Yuffie, and the rest of the party in perhaps the grandest conclusion the genre has seen in quite some time. An essential finale that targets existing fans more than newcomers, FF7 Revelation promises to go out with a bang, cementing the remake trilogy’s status among the most definitive in gaming. And one of the longest, if not the longest.

Biggest 2026 Games Delayed To 2027 (So Far)

Stay patient, as these anticipated games won't be available this year as initially expected, but they're set to release in 2027.

By Vlad Mazanko

Final Fantasy 7 Revelation seems like yet another exercise in expanding the scope, as Square Enix shows no signs of stopping when it comes to the size of its world, explorable aboard the Highwind airship. That ambition also extends to layered combat built around powerful synergies, exploration with instant character switching, quests that change depending on who undertakes them, and completely new storylines, activities, and twists. It’s no secret that the FF7 trilogy is far more than a simple remake, so it’s hard not to wonder just how grandiose this final chapter will be.

Fallout 76: Raven Rock

Coming Summer 2027

Fallout fans got some pretty exciting news this year, with numerous projects to look forward to, from remasters of Fallout 3 and New Vegas to confirmation that Fallout 5 is in development. There are no firm release dates for these yet, so Fallout 76 takes the spotlight in 2027 with a major free update, Raven Rock , described as a prequel to Fallout 3 .

6 Must-Play RPGs Releasing in November 2026, Ranked

2026 has been a great year for role-playing games, and November is not changing that. If you want a new RPG, check out these games.

By Ollie Tuscarny

Despite being a free update, Raven Rock is shaping up to be really big: the third map expansion for Fallout 76 , extending the world seamlessly toward the Capital Wasteland. An Enclave storyline takes center stage, potentially enriching the entire series’ lore in the process. More F76 additions are on the menu as well, including new territory for C.A.M.P. building and environmental hazards that affect how you explore.

Monster Hunter Wilds: Ascendance

Coming TBA 2027

Monster Hunter Wilds: Ascendance could quite possibly be the biggest expansion of 2027, surpassing even Songs of the Past. That’s at least judging by the scope of Monster Hunter World: Iceborne , the team’s repeated descriptions of the DLC as “massive,” and how much Capcom has to gain from winning over players disappointed by the base game’s launch. While MH Wilds’ post-launch updates have already addressed many of the release version’s issues, Ascendance might be the perfect time to jump in if you’ve been on the fence.

Biggest Open-World Games Releasing in November 2026, Ranked

Even if you don’t care for GTA 6, November still has something in store for open-world fans.

1
By Vlad Mazanko

Ascendance directly continues the Expedition Team’s story, moving several years beyond the base game and introducing the massive floating region of Skybound Eyrie. New and returning monsters, including Elder Dragons, join substantial gameplay additions like Master Rank and Boost Action. As Monster Hunter games have always been all about the endgame, Ascendance aims to push that appeal even further, giving players more incentive to keep hunting.

Remastered update, and that’s just the beginning. To push things further, The Witcher 3 is getting a third major expansion, Songs of the Past , sometime next year, putting Geralt’s old friend Dandelion at the center of a new adventure that will presumably serve as a bridge between the Geralt trilogy and the upcoming Ciri saga.

Co-developed by CD Projekt Red and Fool’s Theory (the studio responsible for The Witcher 1 Remake ), Songs of the Past is described as closer in scope to Blood and Wine: a massive new region, Letten, branching storylines, new enemies and bosses, and even a new chain weapon for Geralt. Building on the improvements in the Remastered version, Songs of the Past could be its most interesting expansion in terms of gameplay, and there’s little doubt it will be a worthy addition to the legendary open-world RPG.

Fable

Coming February 23

Fable offers a different kind of return, but it’s nevertheless a perfect fit for the topic. A full-fledged franchise reboot from a new developer under the same name, arriving 17 years after Fable 3 , is about as long-awaited a comeback as it gets. The game will probably be vastly different from its predecessors, but based on the showcases, Playground Games has managed to capture Fable’s unmistakable spirit, which is what matters most.

New Turn-Based RPGs Basically Confirmed For 2027

These are the turn-based RPGs to watch in 2027, from Persona 4: Golden to UnderRail 2, big sequels and weird spin-offs are on the horizon.

By Ollie Tuscarny

The return to Albion with a customizable hero and British humor has one unbeatable ace up its sleeve beyond the new combat system and fully open world. So far, Fable looks like a true fantasy life simulator, with over 1,000 handcrafted NPCs, dynamic relationships, jobs, property ownership, and reputation all contributing to a world that feels alive and reactive. Iconic characters like Jack of Blades are also returning, promising unexpected twists and fresh takes on familiar lore. The only thing that’s slightly alarming is the developer’s estimate of around 20 hours for the main story, which seems particularly light for a massive open-world RPG.

Starfield: Starborn

Coming TBA 2027

In many ways, Starfield unfortunately failed to live up to expectations as the next major chapter for Bethesda’s open-world RPGs, but it could still be too early to write it off. Post-launch support has been pretty uneven, with both the Shattered Space and Terran Armada expansions doing too little to shake things up. Yet updates like Free Lanes have definitely been steps in the right direction for expanding and improving the experience.

New Open-World RPGs Basically Confirmed For 2027

From new entries in popular series to completely new IPs, 2027 looks promising for the open-world RPG genre, so what are we playing?

2
By Vlad Mazanko

That’s where Starborn (title unconfirmed) comes in. This is easily the least detailed return announcement on the list, so we don’t yet know whether “Starborn content” means a massive expansion, smaller DLC, or a major update like Free Lanes to further improve the base game for all owners. Still, Bethesda has promised Starborn for 2027, meaning Starfield will stay relevant into next year, potentially reaching its best form and offering an ideal entry point after more than three years of improvements.

Final Fantasy 7 Revelation

Coming April 8

Wait, what’s this doing here? Final Fantasy 7 Revelation isn’t a return, it’s a brand-new game! Sure, but it’s also a direct continuation of the new FF7 saga, meaning the return of Cloud, Tifa, Barret, Yuffie, and the rest of the party in perhaps the grandest conclusion the genre has seen in quite some time. An essential finale that targets existing fans more than newcomers, FF7 Revelation promises to go out with a bang, cementing the remake trilogy’s status among the most definitive in gaming. And one of the longest, if not the longest.

Biggest 2026 Games Delayed To 2027 (So Far)

Stay patient, as these anticipated games won't be available this year as initially expected, but they're set to release in 2027.

By Vlad Mazanko

Final Fantasy 7 Revelation seems like yet another exercise in expanding the scope, as Square Enix shows no signs of stopping when it comes to the size of its world, explorable aboard the Highwind airship. That ambition also extends to layered combat built around powerful synergies, exploration with instant character switching, quests that change depending on who undertakes them, and completely new storylines, activities, and twists. It’s no secret that the FF7 trilogy is far more than a simple remake, so it’s hard not to wonder just how grandiose this final chapter will be.

Fallout 76: Raven Rock

Coming Summer 2027

Fallout fans got some pretty exciting news this year, with numerous projects to look forward to, from remasters of Fallout 3 and New Vegas to confirmation that Fallout 5 is in development. There are no firm release dates for these yet, so Fallout 76 takes the spotlight in 2027 with a major free update, Raven Rock , described as a prequel to Fallout 3 .

6 Must-Play RPGs Releasing in November 2026, Ranked

2026 has been a great year for role-playing games, and November is not changing that. If you want a new RPG, check out these games.

By Ollie Tuscarny

Despite being a free update, Raven Rock is shaping up to be really big: the third map expansion for Fallout 76 , extending the world seamlessly toward the Capital Wasteland. An Enclave storyline takes center stage, potentially enriching the entire series’ lore in the process. More F76 additions are on the menu as well, including new territory for C.A.M.P. building and environmental hazards that affect how you explore.

Monster Hunter Wilds: Ascendance

Coming TBA 2027

Monster Hunter Wilds: Ascendance could quite possibly be the biggest expansion of 2027, surpassing even Songs of the Past. That’s at least judging by the scope of Monster Hunter World: Iceborne , the team’s repeated descriptions of the DLC as “massive,” and how much Capcom has to gain from winning over players disappointed by the base game’s launch. While MH Wilds’ post-launch updates have already addressed many of the release version’s issues, Ascendance might be the perfect time to jump in if you’ve been on the fence.

Biggest Open-World Games Releasing in November 2026, Ranked

Even if you don’t care for GTA 6, November still has something in store for open-world fans.

1
By Vlad Mazanko

Ascendance directly continues the Expedition Team’s story, moving several years beyond the base game and introducing the massive floating region of Skybound Eyrie. New and returning monsters, including Elder Dragons, join substantial gameplay additions like Master Rank and Boost Action. As Monster Hunter games have always been all about the endgame, Ascendance aims to push that appeal even further, giving players more incentive to keep hunting.

item.title: Bethesda Previews Big Fallout 76 Updates for December 2026 and Spring 2027
item.description:
Bethesda has launched a new Fallout 76 Public Test Server build previewing content planned for the game's next two major update windows. Some of the features included in the latest PTS release are planned to join Fallout 76 as early as December 2026, with the rest expected to materialize in 2027.

Add GameRant on Google Add as Preferred Source Follow on Google Discover

Bethesda first outlined both additions in September, while outlining its Fallout 76 content roadmap for the rest of 2026 and 2027. As usual, the upcoming features first arrived on the game's experimental PTS channel, with testing for them now officially expanding beyond PC to include the Xbox Series X/S and PlayStation 5.

Fallout: Raven Rock Officially Confirmed for 2027

Fans of the Fallout franchise can look forward to the release of Raven Rock, which is set to release next year.

3
By Dalton Cooper

Fallout 76's December 2026 Update Is Headlined by World Pets

The first of the two additions is Fallout 76 's much-anticipated World Pets update, which Bethesda plans to release on December 1. The feature will allow existing C.A.M.P. pets to accompany players while exploring Appalachia, introducing commands to make them stay put, remain neutral, attack enemies, or focus on protecting their owner. Since pets will be able to participate in combat, they will also be revivable with Stimpaks when downed. The system will come with some restrictions, like not allowing pets in Raids or Shelters.

World Pets will also introduce a sizable progression system, with companions able to reach level 200. Progress is tracked by species rather than by individual creature, which should streamline gameplay and result in a more accessible leveling loop. The progression grind can improve pet health and damage while also unlocking player bonuses and cosmetic rewards such as Fallout 76 outfits, backpacks, and Player Titles. Pets can also learn passive abilities, with up to two active at once. Bethesda recently expanded the system so that abilities learned by one species can be used with another.

Two iconic game characters. One impossible mashup.
Can you name them both?

The December 2026 update will extend beyond companions with a broader rework of Fallout 76 's Skyline Valley region. Bethesda has refined parts of the map's mountains and hillsides, added new pathways and vegetation, and improved its lighting and weather. Skyline Valley will also gain Bounty Hunting, with the Trading Post serving as a hub where players can obtain targets from a reprogrammed Robobrain named Marshal Canton. Another new questline arriving in December will revolve around collectible glass canisters that appear to contain living brain specimens, with finding the first one setting players on the trail of the rest.

Fallout 76 Crossplay Has a New Argument in Its Favor After the PS5 and Xbox Series Upgrade
Fallout 76's World Pets Update Is Giving Fallout 5 a Companion Problem Before It Even Arrives
Bethesda Gives Official Update on the Future of Fallout

Hideouts Are Coming to Fallout 76 in Spring 2027

The second major feature currently being tested on the PTS is Hideouts, which Bethesda plans to release in spring 2027. These new bounty encounters are intended to bridge the gap between earlier endgame content and Raids, with access revolving around "Leads" that also determine difficulty. Four tiers are currently planned: Basic, Challenging, Lethal, and Marked. The lower difficulties target less experienced characters, while the upper tiers are designed around powerful late-game builds and coordinated teams. Higher-level Leads can be crafted from lower-tier ones and other resources, while accessing Marked difficulty also requires a resource called Drifter Intel. Console players wanting to participate in the Fallout 76 Public Test Server can get started by joining Bethesda's official Discord server. Their PC peers can do the same by simply downloading the PTS client via Steam.
